definition: move toward the speaker or a place
core: 朝说话者或目标靠近，让彼此距离变短。

arrive.vs: 强调到达终点,不含来的过程
arrive.example: We arrived at 8pm sharp after a long drive.
arrive.exampleZh: 经过长途驾驶，我们晚上8点整到达。

approach.vs: 强调接近过程,常搭抽象对象
approach.example: Winter is approaching, so we need warm clothes.
approach.exampleZh: 冬天快到了，所以我们需要保暖衣物。

reach.vs: 强调努力或经过距离够到
reach.example: He reached the summit after hours of climbing.
reach.exampleZh: 经过数小时攀登，他到达了山顶。

example: I'll get a new book tomorrow.
core: 把东西收到手里，或让状态变成新的样子。

obtain.example: She worked hard to obtain a license for her business.
obtain.exampleZh: 她努力工作以获得营业执照。

receive.example: I was happy to receive a gift from my friend.
receive.exampleZh: 我很高兴收到朋友的礼物。

acquire.example: He acquired valuable skills over years of practice.
acquire.exampleZh: 经过多年练习，他获得了宝贵的技能。

core: 把自己这边的东西交到别人那边，让所有权换手。

offer.example: She kindly offered help to the new student.
offer.exampleZh: 她好心地向新学生提供帮助。

hand.example: Could you hand me the salt, please?

present.example: The mayor will present an award to the winner.
present.exampleZh: 市长将向获胜者颁发奖项。

example: We go to school every day.
core: 离开当前位置，朝另一个地方移动过去。

leave.example: I usually leave the office at 6 in the evening.
leave.exampleZh: 我通常晚上6点离开办公室。

depart.example: The train departs at noon from platform 3.
depart.exampleZh: 火车中午从3号站台出发。

proceed.example: Please proceed to gate 5 for boarding.

definition: hold or maintain in a state
core: 把东西或状态留住，不让它跑掉或改变。

hold.example: Could you hold the door for me, please?

retain.example: The company works hard to retain customers.

maintain.example: She exercises daily to maintain good health.
maintain.exampleZh: 她每天锻炼以保持健康。

example: Let me try it once more.
core: 把拦住的门打开，让别人可以自由去做某事。

allow.example: The school does not allow visitors in after 5pm.
allow.exampleZh: 学校下午5点后不允许访客进入。

permit.example: Smoking is not permitted inside the building.

enable.example: This feature enables users to share photos easily.
enable.exampleZh: 这个功能让用户能够轻松分享照片。

example: She made a cake for us.
core: 动手造成一个东西，或让事情变成某种样子。

create.example: The artist loves to create art from recycled materials.
create.exampleZh: 这位艺术家喜欢用回收材料创作艺术。

build.example: They plan to build a house near the lake.
build.exampleZh: 他们计划在湖边盖房子。

produce.example: The factory can produce 1000 units a day.
produce.exampleZh: 这家工厂每天能生产1000件产品。

example: Put the book on the table.
core: 把东西安放到某个位置上，让它停在那里。

place.vs: 比 put 更慎重、有意识
place.example: She placed the vase carefully on the shelf.
place.exampleZh: 她小心地把花瓶放在架子上。

set.example: Please set the table before dinner starts.
set.exampleZh: 晚餐开始前请摆好桌子。

lay.example: She gently laid the baby down in the crib.
lay.exampleZh: 她轻轻地把宝宝放在婴儿床里。

core: 外表给人一种感觉，像是某种情况正在那里。

appear.vs: 比 seem 更基于视觉印象
appear.example: He appears tired after working all night.
appear.exampleZh: 他工作了一整夜后看起来累了。

look.example: You look great today in that dress.
look.exampleZh: 你今天穿那条裙子看起来很棒。

feel like.example: It feels like rain, so take an umbrella.
feel like.exampleZh: 感觉要下雨了，所以带把伞。

core: 伸手拿住并带走，或把递来的东西接过来。

grab.example: Let's grab a coffee before the meeting starts.
grab.exampleZh: 会议开始前我们去喝杯咖啡吧。

carry.example: Don't forget to carry an umbrella today.

accept.example: She decided to accept the job offer happily.
accept.exampleZh: 她高兴地决定接受这份工作提议。

example: To be or not to be.
core: 人或东西就在那里，并处在某种样子里。

exist.example: Do ghosts really exist in this world?
exist.exampleZh: 鬼真的存在于这个世界上吗？

stay.example: I will stay home tonight to rest.

remain.example: Please remain calm during the emergency.
remain.exampleZh: 紧急情况下请保持冷静。

core: 把想做的事落到手上，真的动起来完成它。

perform.example: The surgeon will perform surgery tomorrow morning.
perform.exampleZh: 外科医生明天早上将进行手术。

act.example: We must act quickly to solve this problem.
act.exampleZh: 我们必须迅速行动来解决这个问题。

carry out.example: The team will carry out a plan next week.
carry out.exampleZh: 团队下周将执行一项计划。

core: 某物在自己这边，归自己掌握或随身带着。

own.example: She owns a house in the countryside.
own.exampleZh: 她在乡下拥有一栋房子。

possess.example: He possesses great skill in painting.
possess.exampleZh: 他拥有高超的绘画技能。

hold.example: Please hold a ticket before entering.

example: What did you say to him?
core: 把心里的话用声音或文字送到外面，让别人接到。

speak.vs: 强调说的动作而非内容
speak.example: Please speak loudly so everyone can hear.
speak.exampleZh: 请大声说话，这样每个人都能听到。

tell.example: Tell me a story about your childhood.
tell.exampleZh: 给我讲一个关于你童年的故事。

state.example: Please state your name and address clearly.
state.exampleZh: 请清楚地陈述你的姓名和地址。

core: 眼睛接住画面，心里也可能跟着看明白。

look.example: Look at the sky; it's so beautiful tonight.

view.example: You can view the document online now.
view.exampleZh: 你现在可以在线查看文件。

understand.example: I see your point, but I disagree.
understand.exampleZh: 我明白你的意思，但我不同意。

definition: cause to go or be delivered
exampleZh: 通过邮寄把包裹寄出去。
core: 让人或东西从这里出发，去到指定的另一边。

dispatch.example: We will dispatch the package tomorrow morning.
dispatch.exampleZh: 我们明天早上会发送包裹。

mail.example: I need to mail a letter to my friend.
mail.exampleZh: 我需要寄一封信给我的朋友。

forward.example: Please forward the email to your manager.
forward.exampleZh: 请把邮件转发给你的经理。

core: 门没有关死，事情有机会发生，也可能被允许。

can.vs: 侧重能力或非正式许可
can.example: I can swim across the river easily.

might.vs: 比 may 可能性更低
might.example: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.
might.exampleZh: 待会儿可能会下雨，所以带把伞。

could.vs: 过去式或更礼貌的请求
could.example: Could you help me with this heavy box?
could.exampleZh: 你能帮我搬这个重箱子吗？

core: 意愿或安排朝将来伸出去，准备在那里发生。

shall.example: You shall not pass this gate without permission.
shall.exampleZh: 未经许可，你不准通过这道门。

intend to.example: I intend to leave early tomorrow morning.
intend to.exampleZh: 我打算明天早上早点离开。

be going to.example: It's going to rain, so bring a coat.
be going to.exampleZh: 要下雨了，所以带件外套。

core: 话题围着某件事转，数量也可能只在附近。

concerning.example: I have a question concerning your request.
concerning.exampleZh: 关于你的请求，我有一个问题。

regarding.example: Please email me regarding the meeting time.
regarding.exampleZh: 关于会议时间，请发邮件给我。

around.vs: 侧重 "大约" 而非 "关于"
around.example: There were around 50 people at the party.

core: 从一边横过去，穿过中间来到另一边那头。

over.example: The cat can jump over the fence easily.

through.example: We walked through the tunnel to the other side.
through.exampleZh: 我们穿过隧道到了另一边。

beyond.example: The village lies beyond the mountains.

core: 跟在某时某物后面，顺序落在它的后头。

following.example: Following the meeting, we signed the contract.
following.exampleZh: 会议之后，我们签了合同。

behind.example: Please sit behind me during the show.
behind.exampleZh: 演出期间请坐在我后面。

later than.example: The train arrived later than expected.

example: The ladder leans against the wall.
core: 迎着相反力量顶上去，或身体贴到某物上。

opposing.example: They held opposing views on the new policy.
opposing.exampleZh: 他们对新政策持相反观点。

versus.example: The match is Team A versus Team B.

contrary to.example: His actions were contrary to the rules.

definition: in the middle of a group
example: She is popular among her friends.
core: 被一群人或物围住，落在它们中间的位置。

amid.vs: 文学性强,常搭抽象事物
amid.example: She remained calm amid the chaos.

amongst.exampleZh: 他在朋友之间感到自在。

between.example: This secret stays between you and me.
between.exampleZh: 这个秘密只在你我之间。

core: 把目光钉在一个精确的点上，可能是地点或时刻。

by.example: I like to sit by the window.

near.example: There is a hotel near the station.

in.example: The keys are in the box.

core: 排在某事前面，时间或位置都更早一些。

ahead of.example: We finished the project ahead of schedule.

earlier.example: I met her earlier this week.
earlier.exampleZh: 我本周早些时候见过她。

definition: in the space separating two things
core: 落在两个东西中间，被两边夹在当中位置。

amid.example: He lost his friend amid the crowd.
amid.exampleZh: 他在人群中找不到朋友了。

amongst.example: She chose the best amongst many options.
amongst.exampleZh: 她在众多选择中选了最好的。

in the middle of.example: He called me in the middle of dinner.
in the middle of.exampleZh: 他在晚餐期间给我打了电话。

definition: via, near, or no later than
example: The book was written by her.
core: 靠在某处旁边，或借某条路、某个人完成。

via.example: Please send the report via email.
via.exampleZh: 请通过电子邮件发送报告。

through.exampleZh: 你可以通过实践来学习。

beside.example: We had a picnic beside the lake.

definition: to or in a lower position
core: 朝低处去，位置顺着方向一点点往下落。

downward.example: The economy shows a downward trend.

lower.example: Could you please lower the volume?

core: 离开起点，带着来源的痕迹一路向外出来。

out of.example: She walked out of the house quickly.

since.exampleZh: 自1990年以来我一直住在这里。

core: 被放进里面，处在边界包住的空间之中。

inside.example: The dog is inside the car.

into.example: She walked into the room quietly.

core: 从接触处脱开，离开原来的连接或开关。

away.example: Please go away and leave me alone.
away.exampleZh: 请走开，让我一个人待着。

apart.example: They live miles apart from each other.

disconnected.example: After moving, I feel disconnected from my friends.
disconnected.exampleZh: 搬家后，我感到与朋友们疏离了。

example: The cat is on the chair.
core: 贴在表面上，或让机器进入工作状态里。

upon.example: Once upon a time, there was a brave knight.
upon.exampleZh: 从前，有一位勇敢的骑士。

atop.example: The castle stood atop the hill, overlooking the valley.
atop.exampleZh: 城堡矗立在山顶，俯瞰着山谷。

over.example: I'm grateful to have a roof over my head.

example: The plane flew over the city.
core: 在上方越过，或数量盖过某个限度线之上。

above.example: The plane flew above the clouds, far above the city.
above.exampleZh: 飞机在云层之上飞行，远高于城市。

beyond.example: The treasure was hidden beyond reach of the villagers.
beyond.exampleZh: 宝藏藏在村民们够不着的地方。

across.example: We swam across the river to reach the other side.
across.exampleZh: 我们游过河到达了对岸。

definition: from one side to the other
core: 从里面穿过去，一头进去再从另一头出来。

across.example: The children ran across the field, laughing loudly.
across.exampleZh: 孩子们穿过田野，大声笑着。

via.example: We flew to London via Tokyo to save money.
via.exampleZh: 我们经由东京飞往伦敦以省钱。

by means of.example: They solved the conflict by means of force.
by means of.exampleZh: 他们通过武力解决了冲突。

core: 朝目标走去，方向一直指到某个终点那里。

toward.example: She started to walk toward the door, then stopped.
toward.exampleZh: 她开始朝门走去，然后停了下来。

until.example: Please wait until 5 o'clock for the results.

into.example: The boy dared to jump into the pool first.
into.exampleZh: 那个男孩敢第一个跳进游泳池。

example: The cat hides under the bed.
core: 压在或藏在下方，被上面的东西盖住遮住。

beneath.example: Beneath the surface, the ocean hides many secrets.
beneath.exampleZh: 表面之下，海洋隐藏着许多秘密。

below.example: The temperature dropped below the line last night.
below.exampleZh: 昨晚温度降到了线以下。

underneath.example: The cat hid underneath the bed during the storm.
underneath.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，猫躲在床底下。

definition: to or in a higher position
core: 朝高处去，位置顺着方向一点点往上升。

upward.example: She gave an upward glance at the tall building.
upward.exampleZh: 她向上瞥了一眼那座高楼。

above.example: The birds flew above the trees, singing happily.
above.exampleZh: 鸟儿在树的上方飞翔，快乐地歌唱。

higher.example: He trained hard to climb higher than ever before.
higher.exampleZh: 他努力训练，爬得比以前更高。

core: 和某人某物在一起，动作或状态彼此相伴。

alongside.example: I enjoy working alongside her on this project.
alongside.exampleZh: 我喜欢在这个项目上和她一起工作。

together with.example: She traveled together with her family to the beach.
together with.exampleZh: 她和她的家人一起去了海滩旅行。

including.example: The total cost is $100, including taxes and fees.
including.exampleZh: 总费用是100美元，包括税费。

definition: in the role of or while
core: 把人或事放进某个身份、样子，或同一时间里。

like.example: He runs like the wind, fast and unstoppable.
like.exampleZh: 他跑得像风一样快，势不可挡。

while.example: Please read this book while you wait for me.
while.exampleZh: 在你等我的时候，请读这本书。

because.example: I did it as you asked, without any hesitation.
because.exampleZh: 我按照你的要求做了，没有犹豫。

core: 心思或用途朝向某人某事，背后带着原因。

because of.example: The game was canceled because of the heavy rain.

intended for.example: This toy is intended for children under five years old.
intended for.exampleZh: 这个玩具专为五岁以下儿童设计。

on behalf of.example: I speak on behalf of the team when I thank you.

core: 把一个东西连到它的所属、来源或组成上。

belonging to.example: This necklace is belonging to her grandmother.
belonging to.exampleZh: 这条项链属于她的祖母。

from.example: I received a gift from Mom yesterday.
from.exampleZh: 我昨天收到了妈妈送的礼物。

about.example: She is reading a book about birds now.
about.exampleZh: 她正在读一本关于鸟类的书。

core: 时间一路延到某个点，到了那里才停下来。

until.example: The store is open until midnight tonight.
until.exampleZh: 这家店今晚营业到午夜。

up to.example: The event can host up to 100 people.
up to.exampleZh: 这个活动最多可容纳100人。

through.example: The museum is open through Sunday this week.
through.exampleZh: 博物馆这周一直营业到周日。

core: 把两边拉出来比较，看哪一边更怎样一些。

compared to.example: Sales increased compared to last year.
compared to.exampleZh: 销售额与去年相比有所增长。

versus.example: We debated safety versus speed today.
versus.exampleZh: 我们今天讨论了安全与速度的对比。

over.example: She chose tea over coffee this morning.
over.exampleZh: 她今早选了茶而不是咖啡。

core: 从同类中随手拎出一个，不指定具体是哪一个。

one.example: He ate one apple, not two.
one.exampleZh: 他吃了一个苹果，不是两个。

any.example: You can borrow any book will do.

some.example: Some guy called while you were out.
some.exampleZh: 你出去的时候有个家伙打过电话。

example: The book is on the desk.
core: 手指点向已知道的那一个，不是随便一个。

this.example: Please read this book here carefully.
this.exampleZh: 请仔细阅读这本书在这里。

that.example: Can you see that one over there?

said.example: The said agreement was signed yesterday.

core: 把一整堆都收进来，一个也不落在外面。

every.example: Every student passed the final exam.
every.exampleZh: 每个学生都通过了期末考试。

entire.example: She worked for the entire day without rest.
entire.exampleZh: 她工作了一整天没有休息。

whole.example: He ate the whole pizza by himself.
whole.exampleZh: 他一个人吃了整个披萨。

definition: one or some, no matter which
core: 随便哪一个都可以，不需要先挑定对象。

some.vs: 肯定句用 some,疑问用 any
some.example: Could I have some water, please?

every.example: Remember that every chance counts in life.
every.exampleZh: 记住，每一次机会在生活中都很重要。

whichever.example: You can take whichever you prefer.
whichever.exampleZh: 你可以随便选你喜欢的那个。

core: 一个接一个全算进去，没有任何一个漏掉。

each.example: Each child got a gift at the party.
each.exampleZh: 每个孩子在派对上得到了一份礼物。

all.example: All the kids ran to the playground.
all.exampleZh: 所有孩子都跑向了操场。

any.example: You can pick any one from the box.
any.exampleZh: 你可以从盒子里随便挑一个。

core: 数量或尺寸很小，只占很少的一点点空间。

small.example: She has a small dog at home.

slight.example: There was a slight delay in the flight.

tiny.vs: 比 little 更小,情感色彩
tiny.example: The mother held a tiny baby in her arms.
tiny.exampleZh: 母亲怀里抱着一个很小的婴儿。

core: 量堆得很多，感觉分量很足很满很重。

a lot.example: We had a lot of fun at the park.
a lot.exampleZh: 我们在公园玩得很开心。

plenty.example: We still have plenty of time left.

greatly.example: Her performance has greatly improved this year.
greatly.exampleZh: 她的表现今年大大改善了。

core: 把可能性关掉，留下空无、拒绝或不存在。

not.example: You must not enter this area without permission.
not.exampleZh: 未经许可，你不得进入这个区域。

none.example: None of them came to the party last night.
none.exampleZh: 他们昨晚一个都没来参加派对。

zero.example: The school has a zero tolerance policy for bullying.
zero.exampleZh: 这所学校对欺凌行为实行零容忍政策。

core: 从眼前这个换到另一个不同的对象那边。

another.example: I hope you can give me another chance to prove myself.
another.exampleZh: 我希望你能再给我一次机会证明自己。

different.example: We need a different approach to solve this problem.
different.exampleZh: 我们需要一种不同的方法来解决这个问题。

alternative.example: Take an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
alternative.exampleZh: 走另一条路线以避开交通堵塞。

core: 拿出一点或几个，但不把全部数量说清楚。

a few.example: I invited a few friends to my birthday party.
a few.exampleZh: 我邀请了几个朋友来参加我的生日派对。

several.example: There are several reasons why I disagree with you.
several.exampleZh: 我有几个理由不同意你的看法。

any.example: Are there any volunteers for the cleanup event?
any.exampleZh: 有志愿者参加清洁活动吗？

core: 把眼前东西归到这种样子、这种程度里。

like that.example: I would never trust a person like that again.
like that.exampleZh: 我再也不会信任那样的人了。

this kind of.example: We must find a solution to this kind of problem.
this kind of.exampleZh: 我们必须找到解决这类问题的方法。

so.example: After the long hike, I felt so tired that I fell asleep.
so.exampleZh: 长途徒步后，我太累了，直接睡着了。

core: 手指向较远处，或指回已经提到的那个东西。

which.example: I bought the book, which is new and very popular.
which.exampleZh: 我买了那本新书，它很受欢迎。

the one.example: This is the one I want for my collection.
the one.exampleZh: 这就是我想要的那个，用于我的收藏。

yon.example: Look at yon castle on the distant hill.

core: 手指向眼前近处，或正在谈的这个东西。

the present.example: We must focus on the present situation, not the past.
the present.exampleZh: 我们必须关注当前情况，而不是过去。

the current.example: The current trend in fashion is very colorful.
the current.exampleZh: 当前的时尚趋势非常多彩。

here.example: The people here are very friendly and helpful.
here.exampleZh: 这里的人非常友好和乐于助人。

core: 说话的人把自己放在句子中心，从自己出发。

me.example: Please give it to me when you are done.

myself.example: I did it myself without any help from others.
myself.exampleZh: 我自己做的，没有别人帮忙。

self.example: Meditation helps improve your sense of self.
self.exampleZh: 冥想有助于提升你的自我意识。

core: 把话里的男性单独拎出来，继续指向他。

him.example: Please tell him to come to the meeting tomorrow.

that man.example: That man over there is my new neighbor.
that man.exampleZh: 那边那个男人是我的新邻居。

the male.example: The male of the species is usually larger.
the male.exampleZh: 该物种的雄性通常体型更大。

core: 说话时把目光对准听话的人，让话落到对方身上。

thou.example: Thou shalt not steal, as the commandment says.
thou.exampleZh: 你不可偷盗，正如诫命所说。

ye.example: Hear ye, hear ye, the king has arrived!
ye.exampleZh: 听好了，听好了，国王驾到！

one.example: One must be careful when crossing the street.

core: 把问题投向某个人，追问到底是哪一位。

which person.example: Which person did it? I need to know the truth.
which person.exampleZh: 哪个人做的？我需要知道真相。

what person.example: What person could that be, knocking so late?
what person.exampleZh: 那会是什么人，这么晚敲门？

whom.example: To whom it may concern, please read this letter.

core: 把两个想法或东西并排接上，让它们同在。

also.example: We can go today and also tomorrow.
also.exampleZh: 我们可以今天去，而且明天也去。

as well as.example: She sings as well as dances beautifully.
as well as.exampleZh: 她既唱歌又跳舞，而且舞跳得很美。

core: 在事情后面接上一条原因，说明为什么会这样。

since.example: Since you asked, I will tell you.
since.exampleZh: 既然你问了，我就告诉你。

as.example: As it was raining, we stayed inside.
as.exampleZh: 因为在下雨，我们待在了室内。

due to.example: The game was canceled due to the rain.
due to.exampleZh: 比赛由于下雨被取消了。

core: 前后方向忽然一转，后面挡住前面的预期。

yet.example: This device is small yet powerful.

however.example: We failed; however, we tried our best.
however.exampleZh: 我们失败了；然而，我们尽力了。

though.example: The hotel is nice, though pricey.

core: 摆出几条可能的路，让人从中挑选一条。

either.example: You can have either tea or coffee.
either.exampleZh: 你可以要么茶要么咖啡。

alternatively.example: You can drive; alternatively, take the bus.
alternatively.exampleZh: 你可以开车；或者，坐公交车。

otherwise.example: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss it.

core: 先放一个条件，条件成立时事情才往下走。

provided that.example: I will go provided that you agree.

when.example: When you arrive, call me immediately.
when.exampleZh: 你到了就马上给我打电话。

supposing.example: Supposing he refused, what would you do?
supposing.exampleZh: 假设他拒绝了，你会怎么做？

core: 先承认阻碍还在，事情却仍然照样发生。

although.example: Although it was cold, we went out.
although.exampleZh: 虽然天气很冷，我们还是出去了。

even if.example: Even if it rains, we will go.

despite.example: He slept well despite the noise.
despite.exampleZh: 尽管有噪音，他睡得很好。

core: 两件事在同一段时间里一起并行发生。

during.example: Please don't talk during the meeting.

whereas.example: He likes tea, whereas I prefer coffee.
whereas.exampleZh: 他喜欢茶，而我更喜欢咖啡。

as.example: As we spoke, it started to rain.
as.exampleZh: 我们说话时，开始下雨了。

core: 追问动作走哪条路、用什么方式完成它。

in what way.example: In what way did it help you?

by what means.example: By what means did they enter the building?
by what means.exampleZh: 他们通过什么方式进入大楼的？

what way.example: What way is best to solve this?
what way.exampleZh: 哪种方式解决这个问题最好？

core: 把问题钉到时间点上，问事情何时发生。

at what time.example: At what time will you arrive?

once.example: Once you finish, you can leave.

as soon as.example: Call me as soon as I know.
as soon as.exampleZh: 我一知道就给你打电话。

core: 把问题钉到地点上，问东西到底落在哪里。

at what place.example: At what place did they meet?

wherever.example: I will follow you wherever you go.
wherever.exampleZh: 无论你去哪里，我都会跟着你。

at the place.example: We met at the place we agreed on.
at the place.exampleZh: 我们在约好的地方见面了。

core: 往事情背后追，寻找推动它发生的原因。

for what reason.example: For what reason did he leave the meeting early?
for what reason.exampleZh: 他提前离开会议是出于什么理由？

how come.example: How come you're late for the party?
how come.exampleZh: 你怎么会迟到参加派对？

wherefore.example: Wherefore art thou Romeo, my love?
wherefore.exampleZh: 罗密欧啊，你为什么是我的爱人？

core: 同一个动作或情况重新出现，再来一遍。

once more.example: Please sing the song once more, with feeling.
once more.exampleZh: 请带着感情再唱一遍这首歌。

anew.example: After the failure, they decided to begin anew.
anew.exampleZh: 失败之后，他们决定重新开始。

afresh.example: She moved to a new city to start afresh.
afresh.exampleZh: 她搬到一个新城市重新开始生活。

example: Have you ever been to Paris?
core: 把时间范围打开，问任意时候是否发生。

always.example: She is always on time for every appointment.
always.exampleZh: 她每次约会总是准时到达。

at any time.example: You can call me at any time if needed.
at any time.exampleZh: 如果有需要，你可以随时给我打电话。

forever.example: They promised to love each other forever and ever.
forever.exampleZh: 他们承诺永远永远相爱。

core: 距离被拉长，离这里或目标变得很远很远。

distant.example: He dreamed of traveling to distant lands one day.
distant.exampleZh: 他梦想有一天去遥远的地方旅行。

remote.example: They lived in a remote village without electricity.
remote.exampleZh: 他们住在一个没有电的偏远村庄。

afar.example: The castle could be seen from afar on the hill.
afar.exampleZh: 从远处就能看到山丘上的城堡。

core: 朝脸所向的前方推进，往前走出一步去。

onward.example: The team marched onward and upward despite difficulties.
onward.exampleZh: 尽管困难重重，团队仍向前向上行进。

ahead.example: We must look ahead and plan for the future.
ahead.exampleZh: 我们必须向前看，为未来做计划。

frontward.example: The soldiers stood facing frontward in formation.
frontward.exampleZh: 士兵们列队面朝前方站立。

core: 说话者所在或手正指着的这个地方这里。

at this place.example: We agreed to meet at this place tomorrow morning.
at this place.exampleZh: 我们约定明天早上在此地见面。

hither.example: The wizard commanded the spirits to come hither.
hither.exampleZh: 巫师命令精灵们到这边来。

in this spot.example: The treasure map says X marks the spot here.

core: 距离很短，已经靠得几乎贴到身边附近。

close.example: The supermarket is very close to home for us.

beside.example: She placed the lamp beside the bed carefully.
beside.exampleZh: 她小心地把灯放在床边。

nearby.example: There is a shop nearby that sells fresh bread.
nearby.exampleZh: 附近有一家卖新鲜面包的店。

core: 时间落在正在发生的这一刻，不是过去将来。

currently.example: The product is currently unavailable due to demand.
currently.exampleZh: 该产品因需求量大目前不可用。

at present.example: At present, no comment can be made on this issue.
at present.exampleZh: 目前对此问题无可奉告。

right away.example: Please do it right away before you forget.

core: 从里面离开，跨出边界来到外面空间。

outside.example: The children love to play outside in the garden.
outside.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢在花园外面玩。

outward.example: Her outward appearance showed no sign of worry.
outward.exampleZh: 她的外表看不出任何担忧的迹象。

beyond.example: The dog ran beyond the gate into the field.
beyond.exampleZh: 狗跑出大门外，进了田野。

core: 到现在还没有停，原来的状态继续留着。

yet.example: The work is not done yet, so please wait.

even now.example: Even now, he denies any involvement in the crime.
even now.exampleZh: 即便此刻，他仍否认与犯罪有任何牵连。

nonetheless.example: Nonetheless, we proceeded with the original plan.
nonetheless.exampleZh: 尽管如此，我们还是按原计划继续了。

core: 时间走到那一刻，或下一步顺着接上来。

next.example: Next, add water to the mixture.
next.exampleZh: 接下来，往混合物里加水。

afterward.example: We talked afterward about the plan.
afterward.exampleZh: 之后我们聊了聊那个计划。

at that time.example: I was a child at that time.

core: 指向离说话者较远处的那个地方那边。

at that place.example: At that place, we met for the first time.
at that place.exampleZh: 在那个地方，我们第一次相遇。

yonder.example: The castle stands on yonder hill.
yonder.exampleZh: 城堡矗立在远处的山丘上。

thither.example: The knight decided to go thither.

core: 分开的东西聚到一处，彼此靠拢一起行动。

jointly.example: The company is jointly owned by two families.
jointly.exampleZh: 这家公司由两个家族共同拥有。

collectively.example: The team decided to act collectively.

in unison.example: The crowd began chanting in unison.

core: 事情进行得顺、稳、好，身体状态也正常。

good.example: She found a good job in the city.
good.exampleZh: 她在城里找到了一份好工作。

nicely.example: She was dressed nicely for the party.

properly.example: Children should learn to behave properly.
properly.exampleZh: 孩子们应该学会举止得体。

core: 离完成只差一点，已经很近但还没完全到。

nearly.example: It was nearly midnight when he arrived.

virtually.example: The two designs are virtually identical.

core: 数量刚好够用，不缺也不必继续再添加。

sufficient.example: The police found sufficient evidence to arrest him.
sufficient.exampleZh: 警方找到了充分证据来逮捕他。

adequate.example: He has adequate skills for the job.
adequate.exampleZh: 他有足够技能胜任这份工作。

plenty.example: We have plenty of time to finish.
plenty.exampleZh: 我们有充足的时间来完成。

core: 把意外的一项也拉进来，让语气分量更强。

also.example: Please also bring snacks to the party.

still.example: This solution is still better than the old one.

yet.example: We need to solve yet harder problems.
yet.exampleZh: 我们需要解决更难的问题。

core: 在判断前放一堵墙，把后面的说法否定掉。

no.example: There is no problem with the plan.

never.example: I will never again make that mistake.
never.exampleZh: 我再也不会犯那个错误了。

non-.example: The flight from New York is non-stop.
non-.exampleZh: 从纽约来的航班是不停的。

core: 把范围缩到这一点，其他多的都排除出去。

just.example: Don't worry, it's just a joke.

merely.example: She is merely a child, not an adult.
merely.exampleZh: 她只是个孩子，不是成年人。

solely.example: He is solely responsible for the project.

core: 程度推得比较满，让感觉明显甚至完全。

rather.example: The weather today is rather cold.

fairly.example: This exam was fairly easy for me.
fairly.exampleZh: 这次考试对我来说相当容易。

entirely.example: Her opinion is entirely different from mine.
entirely.exampleZh: 她的意见和我的完全不同。

core: 程度推到这个样子，或顺着它接出结果。

very.example: The weather was very nice for a picnic.

therefore.example: He was late; therefore, we agree to reschedule.
therefore.exampleZh: 他迟到了，因此我们同意改期。

thus.example: The evidence was clear; thus concluded the judge.
thus.exampleZh: 证据确凿，法官因此得出结论。

core: 把程度再往上加，强调强度已经很高很高。

extremely.example: This math problem is extremely difficult to solve.

highly.example: This restaurant is highly recommended by locals.
highly.exampleZh: 这家餐厅被当地人强烈推荐。

really.example: I think this movie is really good.
really.exampleZh: 我觉得这部电影真的很好。

core: 今天之后紧接着到来的那一天，还没发生。

next day.example: She packed her bags; the next day, she left.
next day.exampleZh: 她收拾好行李，第二天就离开了。

the morrow.example: They planned to depart on the morrow.

soon.example: I hope to see you soon.

core: 今天之前刚过去的那一天，已经留在身后。

the day before.example: The day before, he called to confirm.
the day before.exampleZh: 前一天，他打电话确认了。

previously.example: As previously mentioned, the meeting is at noon.

prior day.example: The prior day's report was missing data.
prior day.exampleZh: 前一天的报告缺少数据。

definition: the direction to one's right when facing the setting sun in northern hemisphere
core: 朝地图上方或指南针北端所指的方向前进。

northward.example: The birds travel northward every spring.
northward.exampleZh: 鸟儿每年春天向北旅行。

Arctic direction.example: The ship sailed toward the Arctic direction.

up.example: Head up the map to find the lake.
up.exampleZh: 朝地图上方走就能找到湖。

core: 朝北的反面走，通常是地图下方的方向。

southward.example: The geese are flying southward for winter.

tropical direction.example: The wind blew in the tropical direction.

down.example: We plan to head down south next week.

definition: the direction of the rising sun
example: The sun rises in the east.
core: 朝太阳升起的一边，也就是地图右侧的方向。

eastward.example: The explorers kept sailing eastward for days.
eastward.exampleZh: 探险家们连续几天向东航行。

orient.example: Ancient traders traveled to the Orient.

sunrise side.example: The house sits on the sunrise side of the hill.
sunrise side.exampleZh: 房子坐落在山丘的日出方向。

definition: the direction of the setting sun
example: Drive west to reach the coast.
core: 朝太阳落下的一边，也就是地图左侧的方向。

westward.example: The westward expansion changed the nation.
westward.exampleZh: 西进扩张改变了这个国家。

sunset side.example: The garden is on the sunset side of the house.
sunset side.exampleZh: 花园在房子的日落方向。

occident.example: The Occident has a rich cultural history.
occident.exampleZh: 西方有着丰富的文化历史。

core: 把请求说得柔和，让对方更愿意帮忙回应。

kindly.example: Kindly respond by Friday with your decision.
kindly.exampleZh: 请在周五前回复你的决定。

if you would.example: If you would close the door, it would help.
if you would.exampleZh: 如蒙允许关上门，那就帮了大忙。

pray.example: Pray tell me what happened last night.
pray.exampleZh: 恳请告诉我昨晚发生了什么。

core: 把对方的话接住，并点头认可它是真的。

yeah.example: Yeah, sure, I'll help you with that.

yep.example: Yep, exactly what I was thinking.
